scope: C0 authored conditional selected-cohort model comparison; no original acceptance promotion
cohort: Exact R23 274 released PGC rows, fixed 628 selected marks, 354 undefined moduli; same CMB velocity window, group partition, and realized marks in all candidates
directions: J2000 equatorial unit source vectors by PGC; CF4 J/ApJ/944/94 table2 for 269, CDS VizieR VII/237/pgc unique PGC lookups for five; never substitute group centers
response: Released DMbest in mag; log10(Vcmb/[km/s]) is an observed CMB-frame positive covariate, not a true distance or physical redshift expansion

models.B_optical_STF: baseline + n_x,n_y,n_z + five n^T E_j n STF columns
models.C_union: baseline + n_x,n_y,n_z + K*n_x,K*n_y,K*n_z + five STF columns

K: -5/(ln(10)*Vcmb) mag/(km/s), frozen low-z flow response scenario; PGC9031 at 317 km/s explicitly small-velocity-domain limited
covariance: V(a,b)=diag(s_i^2-a^2)+a^2 11^T+b^2 GG^T; (a,b) in {0,0.055} x {0,0.29} mag; one total authored covariance shape; training-only ML sigma^2
selection: Condition on realized marks and measured covariates. No parent-inclusion law or physical calibration/PV variance claim. No double-count of released width or modulus error components.
folds: Use cached ledger folds only if every observed group is wholly in one fold, otherwise SHA256(group label) modulo five; hold out complete groups
prediction: For train/test blocks, B=V_te,tr V_tr,tr^-1, mean=X_te beta+B(y_tr-X_tr beta), covariance=sigma2_ML_train*(V_te,te-B V_tr,te); normalized plug-in Gaussian joint-block log density; beta/sigma uncertainty omitted
rank: Training-only centering and RMS scaling; SVD whitened design relative thresholds 1e-8,1e-10,1e-12, primary 1e-10. Deficient coefficients remain NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; predictive score only if held-out design annihilates nullspace to scaled 1e-10.
outputs: Full coefficients and covariance including angular 3+5 tensor blocks and cross blocks, nullspace/rank, per-fold joint and per-row scores, signed direction/depth/method residual summaries; all exploratory
limits: At most 60 fold fits and 12 full fits; no Monte Carlo required for this discriminator
stopping: Source/rank/covariance ambiguity or invalid numerical law holds affected candidate and records first raw failure; physical admission remains HOLD
